title: Visual Resonance Echo Lens (VREL)
description: A triadic lens for analyzing mirror-axis invariants across symbolic systems.

writing_system.description: Name of the alphabet, script, or symbol system being analyzed.

epoch.description: Time period or cultural era of the writing system (optional).

vertical_mirror_invariants.description: Characters or glyphs unchanged under vertical-axis reflection.

horizontal_mirror_invariants.description: Characters or glyphs unchanged under horizontal-axis reflection.

dual_axis_invariants.description: Characters or glyphs invariant under both vertical and horizontal reflection.

notes.description: Optional commentary, resonance observations, or structural notes.
